Mallplaza Vespucio

Large south-eastern mall with wide variety and good connectivity for family or full-day shopping.

Best for

  • Variety
  • Families
  • Full-day shopping

Not ideal for

  • Boutique or premium experience

Getting there

Close to Bellavista de La Florida station.

Recommended time: 2–4 hours
